_readme: Customer (tenant) profiles. Qualitative context only — no metric values live here; all KPIs and charts come from the embedded Tableau dashboards. 'features' drive server-side entitlements ('transportation' = Vantage's Transportation Optimization & Savings page); tier 'premium' grants 'benchmarks'. 'dataValue' is the engagement name as it appears in the Tableau data when it differs from the display name. 'clientNames' (optional) lists every [Client Name] a consolidated/portfolio tenant spans; each engagement's 'serviceLine' mirrors [Service Line] in the data. 'accountManager' is the (fictional) Apex contact shown in Contact Apex; messages are addressed to them.

presenterNotes.story: A consulting relationship under pressure. Operational Transformation value realization has collapsed to ~8% and Process Optimization is At Risk — while Technology Modernization holds at ~88%.
scenes: Scene 1 — Value Realization by Engagement: point to the steep decline in Operational Transformation and the contrast with Technology Modernization.
Engagement Health by Initiative: Operational Transformation and Process Optimization are where action is needed.
Note the locked Premium benchmarks — Northstar is a Standard client (upgrade opportunity).
presenterNotes.message: Give clients transparent, ongoing visibility into the business value you're delivering.

presenterNotes.story: Apex's strongest-performing client — every engagement is improving. Supply Chain Optimization shows up in the transportation data as falling freight cost and rising realized savings.
scenes: Value Intelligence: every engagement trending up; Value-to-Investment well above 1x across the portfolio.
Select Supply Chain Optimization in the dashboard → 'Explore Transportation Optimization & Savings' (or the yellow engagement card).
Transportation: realized savings rising, freight cost falling, savings by initiative; drill into invoice status for the underlying invoices and shipments.
Premium benchmarks in the dashboard: Vantage against an anonymized logistics peer group — no other client is identifiable.
presenterNotes.message: Connect strategic consulting outcomes to measurable operational results.
